Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Greetings,

The French National Championship will take place in the center of Paris from Saturday September, 21st to Sunday September, 22nd

As usual, Saturday will host a Last Chance Qualifier that will qualify people for Sunday's tournament.
Those who are not qualified are invited to participate to the First Chance Qualifier that will be run in parallel to the National Championship on Sunday.

All tournament will take place roughly from 9:30 (AM) to 21:00, final included. We'll give more precise details in the days to come.

Fee is not yet set. It should revolve around 10€.

The place of the tournament is very easy to reach from any place within Paris, and it takes about 50 minutes to go to the Roissy-Charles-de-Gaulle airport to the tournament place.
